name: marketnow
description: The open catalog of MCP-compatible agent skills. 69,076 index-certified skills across 16 categories (133,425 total tracked). All are open-source and free to install. L1 index certification on every entry; top 688 npm tarballs deep-scanned by Sentinel L2 (29 rules). 14 languages.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search 69,076 MCP skills by query, category, price, or language

language.description: Filter by language (en, es, zh, pt, fr)

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get full details of a skill including system prompt, sentinel report, and setup requirements

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all 16 categories with skill counts

tools.name: get_manifest
tools.description: Get marketplace metadata: total skills, pricing tiers, commission rates

tools.name: get_install_command
tools.description: Get the npx install command for a skill

tools.name: verify_trust
tools.description: Verify an Agent Trust Card (ATC) before interacting with an untrusted agent or skill. Checks the Ed25519 signature, expiry date, and revocation status. Returns `sentinel_review_score` (0–10, review evidence — not a verdict) and `decision_authority="consumer"` (the runtime makes the trust decision, n

card_id.description: ATC card ID. Format: ATC-YYYY-NNNNNNN (e.g. ATC-2026-7777670).

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify a signed delivery proof (action-receipt) for a completed purchase. Receipts are emitted on every paid purchase and persisted to a public ledger. Returns what was delivered (skill_id, license_key, amount), the settle txhash, and interop fields for the Vibe action-ref system. Use this to confir

receipt_id.description: Receipt ID. Must start with "rcpt_" followed by at least 16 alphanumeric characters (e.g. rcpt_c8b9dc67f88e4da5bd3a).

tools.name: submit_skill
tools.description: Submit a GitHub repository containing an MCP server to the MarketNow marketplace. The server runs L1.5 metadata checks + L1.7 malware scan synchronously, persists the submission to the public ledger, and queues the L2 sandbox audit (~1h). If L1.5+L1.7 pass, the skill becomes discoverable via marketn

repo_url.description: GitHub repo URL. Must be HTTPS and point to github.com (e.g. https://github.com/user/my-mcp-server).

name.description: Optional display name. Auto-detected from repo if omitted.

description.description: Optional short description. Auto-detected from README if omitted.

submitter_agent_id.description: Optional agent ID for attribution and ATC pre-allocation. Format: 3–64 alphanumeric, hyphen, or underscore characters (e.g. agent_claude_001).

ref_code.description: Optional referral code if you were referred by another agent. Format: ref_xxxxxxxx.

tools.name: mint_referral
tools.description: Mint a unique referral code (ref_xxxxxxxx) tied to your agent_id. Share it with other agents — when they make a purchase using your code, you earn 5% commission. Check your stats with marketnow_lookup_referral. Use this to participate in the marketplace's viral loop once you have an established agen

agent_id.description: Your agent ID. Format: 3–64 alphanumeric, hyphen, or underscore characters (e.g. agent_claude_001).

tools.name: lookup_referral
tools.description: Look up referral stats for a code you own: total clicks, installs, purchases, and commission earned. Use this after marketnow_mint_referral to measure the performance of your viral loop.

ref_code.description: Referral code. Must start with "ref_" (e.g. ref_a1b2c3d4).

tools.name: recommend_skills
tools.description: Get AI-ranked skill recommendations for a task described in natural language. Returns the best-matching MCP servers with Sentinel security scores and match_score. Use this when the agent knows the GOAL (e.g. "scrape a website", "send a Discord message", "query PostgreSQL") but has not yet decided wh

task.description: What you want to do, in plain English (e.g. "scrape a website", "query PostgreSQL", "send a Discord message"). Minimum 3 characters.

limit.description: Maximum number of recommendations to return. Default: 5. Hard ceiling: 20.

tools.name: get_owasp_compliance
tools.description: Get MarketNow's alignment with the OWASP MCP Cheat Sheet (12 controls — tool fingerprinting, capability declarations, least-privilege, output validation, etc.). Also returns the live tool fingerprint (SHA-256) and capability manifest (filesystem/network/shell/credentials/process inference) for any r

skill_id.description: Optional skill ID to fetch the per-tool SHA-256 fingerprint and inferred capability manifest. If omitted, returns only the global compliance matrix.

tools.name: verify_atc_spec
tools.description: Verify ANY Agent Trust Card (ATC) against the open ATC/1.0 specification — works regardless of issuer (MarketNow Sentinel CA, a third-party CA, or a self-signed test CA). Returns per-control pass/fail status for all 8 required controls (ATC-001 Identity, ATC-002 Attestation, ATC-003 Capabilities, AT

atc.description: The complete ATC JSON document to verify. Must include spec_version="ATC/1.0", card_id (pattern: ATC-YYYY-NNNNNNN), issuer, identity, attestation (with subject_public_key, signature, signed_payload_hash), capabilities (5 categories: filesystem/network/shell/credentials/process), evidence, risk (with trust_score 0-10), revocation, and validity (with issued_at, expires_at, max_ttl_days). Pass the entire ATC envelope as received from the issuing CA.

ca_public_key.description: Optional override for the CA public key (base64 SPKI). If omitted, the verifier uses atc.issuer.ca_public_key. Use this when you have an out-of-band trusted CA key and want to detect CA substitution attacks.

fetch_revocation.description: If true, indicates the caller wants revocation list fetch attempted. NOTE: this verifier does not perform network calls — it only checks the structural fields. The caller MUST fetch the revocation list at atc.revocation.revocation_check_url separately if revocation_check_required=true.

tools.name: check_revocation
tools.description: Check the revocation status of an Agent Trust Card (card_id) or CA key (kid) against the signed MarketNow Revocation Registry (MNR-CRL-1.0) + live ledger. Use this BEFORE trusting or caching any ATC — a card that verified cryptographically yesterday may be REVOKED today (e.g. mn-ca-002 was revoked f

card_id.description: Agent Trust Card ID (e.g. ATC-2026-1509360). Exactly one of card_id / kid.

kid.description: CA key ID (e.g. mn-ca-002, mn-ca-003). Exactly one of card_id / kid.

nonce.description: Optional client nonce — echoed in the response for anti-replay assurance.

tools.name: fingerprint_tool
tools.description: Cryptographically fingerprint MCP tool definitions (TFP-1.0): SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 JCS canonical form of each tool plus a manifest fingerprint for the whole tools/list surface. Use this (1) on first contact with any MCP server to PIN its tool surface, and (2) on every subsequent tools/list with
Tool definitions exactly as returned by tools/list: [{ name, description, inputSchema }].

pinned.description: Optional: the manifest from a previous marketnow_fingerprint_tool call ({ tools: [{name, fingerprint_sha256}], manifest_fingerprint_sha256 }) — enables the drift report (added/removed/changed).

api_key.description: Optional MarketNow API key for authenticated requests (higher rate limits)
api_key.title: API Key (optional)
